summary: Produced the backend design artefact for ADP-04a at src/design/adp-04a-external-identity-linkage-user.md. The design specifies additive users external identity columns and unique index semantics, explicit migration/backfill compatibility rules for existing internal users, service/repository contracts for realm+sub resolution used by JIT provisioning, and collision-prevention boundaries that preserve IDN-01 while satisfying OIDC-09 and OIDC-11 traceability.

tests_run.name: design completeness and acceptance traceability review
tests_run.detail: Verified the design includes module purpose, public interfaces, data flow, error taxonomy, state transitions, dependencies, open questions, and explicit ADP-04a to IDN-01/OIDC-09/OIDC-11 mapping.
